lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to warn Pharaoh that He will send the worst hail ever to fall on Egypt.
Pharaoh's officials who feared the word of the LORD hurried their servants and livestock to shelter.
Moses stretches out his staff, and the LORD sends thunder and hail on Egypt, but no hail falls on Moab.
Pharaoh admits his sin and asks Moses and Aaron to offer a sacrifice to stop the hail.
Moses spreads out his hands to the LORD and the storm stops, but Pharaoh sins again and hardens his heart.
